sources.title: Activated carbon adsorber ACT series - DirectIndustry
sources.snippet: Overview: The ACT series by Kaeser offers high-performance activated carbon adsorbers designed for continuous operation and maximum compressed air quality. These systems ensure technically oil-free compressed air, meeting the stringent Class 1 purity requirements of ISO 8573-1, with a residual oil content no higher than 0.01 mg/m³.
